name: test
query:
SELECT
    ps.name AS "Project ID:Link/Project Setup:120",
    ps.project_name AS "Project Name::200",
    ps.work_team AS "Work Team:Link/Work Team:120",
    ps.team_leader AS "Team Leader:Link/User:120",
    ps.status AS "Status::100",
    ps.completion_date AS "Completion Date:Date:100",
    MONTHNAME(ps.completion_date) AS "Completion Month::120"
FROM
    `tabProject Setup` ps
WHERE
    ps.status = 'Completed'
    AND ps.name NOT IN (
        SELECT col.object
        FROM `tabCompleted Objects List` col
        INNER JOIN `tabTotal Compensation` tc
        ON col.parent = tc.name
        WHERE tc.docstatus = 1
    )
    -- Filter by completion month (either selected filter or previous month by default)
    AND (
        %(completion_month)s IS NOT NULL
        AND MONTHNAME(ps.completion_date) = %(completion_month)s
        OR %(completion_month)s IS NULL
        AND MONTH(ps.completion_date) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))
    )
ORDER BY ps.completion_date DESC;
